 Chargers vs. Ravens prediction, odds, time: NFL Week 10 'Monday Night Football' picks by proven model
 SportsLine's model has revealed its Los Angeles Chargers vs. Baltimore Ravens picks for 'Monday Night Football' matchup
 By
 Daniel Kohn 
 Nov 15, 2026
 at
 2:21 pm ET 
 •
 2 min read
 Imagn Images 
 The Los Angeles Chargers seek to win their first game of the season when they battle the Baltimore Ravens on 'Monday Night Football.' Los Angeles is coming off a 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans on Nov. 8, while Baltimore dropped a 33-10 decision to the Jacksonville Jaguars on Nov. 5. The Chargers (0-8), who have lost 11 in a row dating back to last season, are 5-7 on the road since the start of last year. The Ravens (4-5), fourth in the AFC North, have dropped four straight. Newly acquired Jacoby Brissett will start at quarterback for Baltimore. Quarterback Justin Herbert (finger) is expected to play for the Chargers. The Over also hit in the Chargers' last game, and is 6-4 in Baltimore's last 10. Despite all of the injuries, the Ravens are still averaging 21 points per game. Los Angeles' defense, meanwhile, is among the league's worst at 27.4 points per game, tied with Carolina at No. 28.
 Despite a banged up finger, quarterback Justin Herbert is still completing 61.3% of his passes for 1,591 yards and six touchdowns. Tight end Oronde Gadsden has been a bright spot in the passing game with 19 receptions for 172 yards and a score. Jacoby Brissett, meanwhile, is completing 63.3% of his passes for 1,719 yards and 10 touchdowns.
